programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El alcalde insiste en ayudarle a Tato. Patricia le dice a Velandia saber del escondite del Avión. El submarino será disfrazado como carroza en la procesión. Bruna amenaza de muerte a Pedro y Mariela.

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: A Day To Die
programme.desc: The high-octane action thriller places Kevin Dillon in a desperate race against time. An ex-military ops officer has one day to raise $2 million to save his kidnapped wife.

programme.title: Operation Mincemeat
programme.desc: John Madden brings to life a remarkable true story that shows that all is fair in war. Two British intelligence officers devise a deceptive plan to outwit German troops during WWII.

programme.title: Death Race
programme.desc: Jason Statham fans will love him in this high-octane action film. In the not-too-distant future, a reality TV show uses prisoners in a deadly race for entertainment.

programme.title: State Of Play
programme.desc: Oscar winners Russell Crowe and Ben Affleck lead a great cast in this drama. After a congressional aide is killed, a journalist starts looking at the case, unearthing dark secrets.

programme.title: Couples Retreat
programme.desc: Vince Vaughn and Jon Favreau write and star in this film about marriage. Four couples and a holiday resort are brought face-to-face with the problems in their relationships.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Gore Verbinski and Johnny Depp (The Pirates of the Caribbean) create an amazing, action-filled animation. A chameleon stuck in a lawless western town becomes its reluctant hero.

programme.title: Dogtanian And The Three Muskehounds
programme.desc: A canine remake of a 1980s cartoon. Dogtanian goes to Paris to join the Muskehounds, and when the evil Richelieu plots to seize power, he and the trio must defend the King.

programme.title: Paddington 2
programme.desc: Paddington's delightful adventures continue in this BAFTA-nominated sequel. After a beloved book is stolen, Paddington and the Browns must find the crafty thief behind the crime.

programme.title: Schuks! Your Country Needs You
programme.desc: Leon Schuster is back in elaborate costumes and makeup to wreak havoc across the country by testing the limits of South Africans in completely bizarre situations.

programme.title: Goodrich
programme.desc: Michael Keaton is exceptional in this bittersweet film. A father seeks help from his first daughter from his first marriage to raise his young kids after his wife checks into rehab.

programme.title: The Fast And The Furious
programme.desc: Vin Diesel and the late Paul Walker team up for the first instalment of the popular franchise, which sees a cop go undercover to infiltrate a racing crew.

programme.title: Durban Poison
programme.desc: Inspired by a true story, this proudly South African movie follows a police investigation into four murders and charts the doomed romance of the outlaw lovers.

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: This biopic imagines Emily Bront's story, which inspired her book Wuthering Heights. While navigating the struggles of family life, she yearns for artistic and personal freedom.

programme.title: Stowaway
programme.desc: A party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Trapped on the high seas, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Kandasamys: The Wedding
programme.desc: The madness continues in this sequel to the hit South African rom-com. It is a week before Jodi and Prishen's wedding and their love is tested as the family interfere once more.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: The gloves come off in this festive comedy with an all-star cast. When a dysfunctional family come together for Christmas, everything else seems to fall apart.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy learns why silence is golden in this hilarious comedy. A fast-talking agent must watch his every word after a spiritual guru attempts to teach him a valuable lesson.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge Of Reason
programme.desc: This sequel to the sweet rom-com classic sees Bridget Jones finally in a stable relationship with Mark Darcy. But doubts brew when her ex-lover, Daniel Cleaver, returns.

programme.title: Spirit: Stallion Of The Cimarron
programme.desc: This Oscar nominee for Best Animated Feature film sees a young mustang stallion become the leader of his herd. But when he is captured, he's forced to fight for his freedom.

programme.title: Mosley
programme.desc: An enchanting family animation. Mosley rebels from a life of servitude to uncover the origins of his species after learning that his fellow thoriphants used to stand upright.

programme.title: Problem Child
programme.desc: Home Alone fans will love this sleeper hit family comedy. When a couple adopts a young boy, they soon discover he's mischievous and destructive.

programme.title: Schuks! Pay Back The Money
programme.desc: The legendary South African comedian, Leon Schuster returns for another crazy film, filled with even bigger antics and chaos.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and Arnold Vosloo face off once again in this sequel. The mummy is resurrected once again. But there is another threat: the Scorpion King and his undead army.

programme.title: The Fate Of The Furious
programme.desc: Bonds are tested in this high-octane instalment of the Furious franchise. A mysterious woman seduces Dom into a world of terrorism, leading him to betray the family.

programme.title: Bandit
programme.desc: Josh Duhamel drives this outrageous heist film based on a true story. After escaping prison, a career criminal assumes a new identity in Canada and goes on a crime spree.
